mods.name: MineshaftMania
mods.description: Glacite Tunnel & Mineshaft analytics for Hypixel SkyBlock — pity tracking, corpse profit, Littlefoot drops.

releases.notes:
First release of MineshaftMania — a Glacite Tunnels & Mineshaft toolkit for Hypixel SkyBlock.

**Features**
- Corpse & fossil in-world waypoints (see-through labels)
- Mineshaft announcer (party chat + on-screen): type, variant, and corpses present
- Shaft stats: pity counter, shafts/vanguard, avg pity at spawn
- Corpse profit tracking (bazaar + auction house pricing) with per-corpse messages
- Littlefoot tracker (fluff, shards, net profit)
- Rare-drop + key-saved notifications, ice-themed /mmania config

**Requirements:** Minecraft 26.1.2, Fabric Loader, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin. Client-side only.

Corpse location data sourced from the SkyOcean community repo (meowdding).
